description: One edit of an agent plan, reported next to the whole new step list by TmAgentPlan.OnPlanChanged: OnPlanChanged(IReadOnlyList<AgentPlanStep> steps, AgentPlanEdit edit). The list is authoritative — a host that keeps the steps applies it and is done. The edit answers the questions a list cannot: WHICH operation the reader performed, at WHICH position, and (for a removal) the removed step itself, so an undo does not have to diff two snapshots. The factories Rename / Add / Remove / Reorder are the only way to build one.
